```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(officer)
library(officedown)
library(flextable)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| tab.cap: "DATAFRAME-CAPTION"

head(mtcars[, 1:3])
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| tab.cap: "FLEXTABLE-CAPTION"

flextable(head(mtcars[, 1:3]))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: tbl-ft

flextable(head(mtcars[, 1:3]))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
set_caption(flextable(head(mtcars[, 1:3])),
            caption = as_paragraph("SETCAPTION-FT"),
            autonum = run_autonum(seq_id = "tab", bkm = "ftset"))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()
```
